svg.title: Shinseina Ki — Sacred Heartwood. Draft 3 / Wood classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 8 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Hallowed Seed forks into Fangs of Heartwood then The Forest Devours, or Rooted in Wisdom then Heartwood Awakened. Grasping Roots forks into Rootbound Prey then Judgement of the Grove. No paths converge. Bonuses affect existing supported tags on Wood-classified Shinseina Ki jutsu.

Raw Wood power is the primary route because it is the kit's own output and its Burst trait; the doubled Forest Wisdom buff is the secondary route because every point lands twice and also lifts normal jutsu, weapons and basic attacks; Grove's exposure is the tertiary route because it is the kit's only enemy debuff and amplifies allies' hits as well. Grove"]}],"narrow_kit_exception":"Eight nodes and three Advanced Arts rather than ten and four. The kit has three supported tags on six rows (Damage x3, Increase Damage Given x2, Increase Damage Taken x1), so it supports exactly three routes: Hallowed Seed forks into a Wood damage route (+6) and a Forest Wisdom route (+7 on two always-together self rows); Grasping Roots \u2192 Rootbound Prey \u2192 Judgement of the Grove is a single chain on the only enemy debuff. Hallowed Seed is therefore a universal node (all 8 legal full builds). A leaf Hidden Art under Grasping Roots, to give that root a 4-BP closure without it, would be filler: every candidate was run through the validator. Damage +1, IDG +2 or Damage +1/IDG +1 leave 06,07,08,09 dominated by 01,06,07,08; Damage +2 is a twin of Fangs of Heartwood (01,06,07,09 = 01,02,06,07; 01,04,06,09 = 01,02,04,06) and its 01,02,06,09 is dominated by 01,02,03,06; Damage +3 or IDG +3 opens a second path to the Damage +6 or IDG +7 maximum; any IDT leaf breaks the +10 guardrail; Damage +2/IDG +1 or Damage +1/IDG +2 out-bid Fangs of Heartwood's hybrids (01,02,04,06 and 01,02,06,07 or 01,04,06,07 become dominated). The layout is kept: Burst and Amplification each have two fourth-purchase choices, the exposure route has one, and three distinct complete builds exist, one per Advanced Art.","design_notes":["Node split: 2 Foundations, 3 Hidden Arts, 3 Advanced Arts. Hallowed Seed (Damage +1 on three rows, IDG +2 on both Forest Wisdom rows; 5 of 6 rows) forks into Fangs of Heartwood \u2192 The Forest Devours (Damage +2/+3) and Rooted in Wisdom \u2192 Heartwood Awakened (IDG +2/+3). Grasping Roots \u2192 Rootbound Prey \u2192 Judgement of the Grove (IDT +2/+3/+5, Damage +1 on the capstone) is the enemy-facing chain. Every Advanced Art is 3 BP deep; any two cost 5 or 6 BP, so a build holds at most one.","Reference reuse: the Damage chain copies Taiyo Kami's Crown of Cinders \u2192 Solar Cataclysm (+2/+3) and the IDT chain its Sunward Oath \u2192 Golden Mantle \u2192 Sovereign Sun +2/+3/+5 ladder, fitting three formula hits and one exposure row. Departures: Hallowed Seed adds Damage +1 (route +6, one above Taiyo's +5; user-owned: 60 AP hits on cooldown 7, one per round); the IDG chain is single-tag (+7 on two always-together rows); Judgement's secondary is Damage +1 (IDG +2 would dominate 01,04,06,07).","Interactions (SOURCE_MECHANICS \u00a73/\u00a73b): Forest Wisdom row 0 (no element, Highest filter) matches the kit's Wood hits, every element-less hit of any stat (basic attacks, weapons, normal jutsu) and any elemental hit of the caster's highest stat; row 1 (Earth/None/Water/Wood) matches those elements and None. Each row adds power/100 \u00d7 the staged base and same-tag rows all apply, so both IDG rows and Grove's exposure add (35+35+35% at base); only the bloodline IDG passive (25+0.15/level) multiplies.","Delivery and timing: every jutsu has cooldown 7, and buff/debuff rows act only in the two rounds after their cast round (\u00a73b). Forest Wisdom is a 40 AP SELF cast realized on the caster; it lifts hits in the next two rounds, never a hit in its own round. Serpent and Eternal Forest are 60 AP single-target hits at range 4. Guardian's Grove is a 60 AP radius-1 circle on an OTHER_USER target at range 4, applied once to each non-caster in it; its exposure never amplifies its own damage row.","Fourth purchases: Burst (01,02,03) finishes with Rooted in Wisdom (buffs 39%; advertised, solo-strongest) or Grasping Roots (exposure 37%; team play); Amplification (01,04,05) with Fangs of Heartwood (hits 43/43/53; advertised) or Grasping Roots; Exposure (01,06,07,08) only with Hallowed Seed. No-capstone hybrids: 01,02,04,06 (43/43/53, 39%, 37%), 01,02,06,07 (43/43/53, 37%, 40%), 01,04,06,07 (41/41/51, 39%, 40%). 8 legal full allocations, all non-dominated, every node in one.","Values held for user decision (OPEN_DECISIONS D8); strongest build 01,02,03,04 is 26 row-weighted on six rows (4.33/row; Taiyo Kami 3.44). Trim levers, not re-validated: Damage +6 \u2192 The Forest Devours +2 (route +5). IDG +7 on two always-together rows realizes +14 per cast over a multiplying passive (Taiyo two-row +5) \u2192 Heartwood Awakened +2 (route +6). IDT +10 on one area row also amplifies allies' hits (Taiyo single-target +7) \u2192 Judgement of the Grove +3 (route +8)."],"risks":["Classification: Wood is not exclusive in the census (Nature's Blessing is an INCLUDE kit with two Wood damage rows), and whether any NORMAL/SPECIAL/EVENT/FORBIDDEN jutsu carries Wood is unverified. The tree assumes a bloodline-scoped whole-kit classification; a bare element match would leak the Damage nodes to Nature's Blessing and vice versa.","Resolver: 2 of the 6 supported rows (Forest Wisdom row 0 and Grove's exposure) have no element and fall back to None under the current resolver, so they are unreachable with affectedElements=['Wood'] without the proposed classification change; reaching them through None would also reach every element-less row on any jutsu the player casts.","Ally hazard: Guardian's Grove row 1 (Wood damage, AOE_CIRCLE_SPAWN, OTHER_USER) has friendly fire absent (= ALL) and the poison row explicit ALL, so allies in the circle take both; the ENEMIES exposure row skips them and the caster is never a target. Hallowed Seed, Fangs of Heartwood, The Forest Devours and Judgement of the Grove raise it (up to 46); positioning, not the node, decides.","Ceilings pending user acceptance (design note 6): Heartwood Awakened puts both Forest Wisdom rows at 42%, +14 over base on the kit's Wood hits and every element-less hit for two rounds, over the multiplying IDG passive (BATTLE_TAG_STACKING on at the pin). Judgement of the Grove makes Grove's area exposure 45% for two rounds and amplifies allies' non-pierce hits as well as the caster's.","Universal opener: every legal full build contains Hallowed Seed because the exposure chain has no other prerequisite-closed fourth purchase. Every leaf candidate under Grasping Roots was validated and rejected as dominated, a Fangs of Heartwood twin, a second path to a maximum or a guardrail breach (narrow-kit exception), so the brief's preference for no mandatory opener is not met.","Damage is formula-calculated (sqrt stat scaling), then Forest Wisdom and Grove's exposure add their percentages of the staged base and the bloodline's IDG passive multiplies, so +6 raw power is not linear +6 damage; realized value depends on stats. Serpent's recoil 40% and Eternal Forest's wound 25% are unsupported and unchanged. No combat simulation was performed.","Ranked modes: skill-tree and bloodline effects are skipped in RANKED_PVP and RANKED_SPARRING at the pin, so no node applies there. g.text: Draft 3 / Wood classification / forked tree · Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Every Shinseina Ki jutsu: existing supported tags qualify; combat scope stays unchanged.
Forest · Wood Serpent · Wisdom · Grove (5 effects)
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
The Forest Devours path + Rooted in Wisdom
Heartwood Awakened path + Fangs of Heartwood
Judgement of the Grove path + Hallowed Seed
IDG: Increase Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Wisdom · Increase Damage Given (each of 2 effects)
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Proposed whole-kit potency classification. Current effect-element matching alone does not provide this inheritance.
8 legal four-skill allocations · 3 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
